plan.title: feat(security): #2980 leftovers sweep + fail-closed contained-writes in task check

narratives.Description: Residual #2980 wave D sweeps remaining product raw write sinks after waves A–C, then enables fail-closed verify:contained-writes in task check. Engine work in packages/core and tasks; docs record residual complete and Go deferred.
narratives.UserStory: As a security maintainer, I want remaining product sinks migrated and the inventory fail-closed in task check, so that new raw product writes cannot land silently.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Run task verify:contained-writes and migrate remaining product modules under packages/core/src (triage writers, task-surface, capacity, category-b, codebase map, policy, swarm, packs, session, product-signal, scm, etc.) to packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts. Step 2: Confirm e2e/parity exclusions from hygiene story in packages/core/src/verify-source/contained-writes.ts. Step 3: Wire verify:contained-writes --enforce into task check via tasks/verify.yml and the check aggregate task. Step 4: Update docs/reference/contained-write.md residual section. Step 5: CHANGELOG cites #2980 residual complete. Verify with task verify:contained-writes -- --enforce and vitest packages/core/src/verify-source. drive-to: merge-ready. Closes #2980 when AC met.
narratives.Traces: Wave D + enforce of #2980; closes #2980 when full residual AC met

narrative.Acceptance: Given task verify:contained-writes runs after this PR, product findings outside allowlisted primitives are zero (or only temporary cited allowlist entries remain).
When task check runs (or staged CI job documents promotion), verify:contained-writes --enforce fails closed on a deliberate product raw write fixture and passes on clean tree.
When CONTAINED_WRITES_ALLOWLIST is opened, it lists only containment primitives plus any temporary cited residual entries.
When docs and CHANGELOG are opened, they record residual complete for #2980 and Go still deferred; issue #2980 can close.
